notes: Hand-curated synthetic fixture for the mid-career e-commerce product manager archetype. One ExpectedUnit per fact-bearing bullet in EXPERIENCE + SIDE PROJECTS sections. Role-intro paragraphs, the WRITING section, and EDUCATION are intentionally not labeled.

expected_units.normalized_summary: Led overhaul of search ranking from BM25 + business rules to a learning-to-rank model with seller-quality, price-competitiveness, and inventory-freshness features; top-10 CTR up 14% and search-attributed GMV per visitor up 9.3%

Owned redesign of search results page with a new query-understanding layer (typo correction, attribute extraction, brand canonicalization) and faceted filter rebuild; zero-result-rate fell from 6.1% to 1.4% and refinement abandons fell 28%

Shipped sponsored listings inline in organic search with relevance floors, take-rate model, and auction-and-ranking interleaving; $24M annualized incremental revenue with no measurable hit to organic CTR or NPS
Killed the category landing pages initiative after a six-week scoping pass; wrote the disconfirming memo and redirected the squad to query-understanding work

Owned the seller-quality signal feeding search ranking — defined a weighted metric across late-shipment rate, defect rate, response time, chargeback rate; shipped seller dashboard and rolled out enforcement to 18,000 sellers in a quarter
Partnered with Pricing on a compare-price treatment in search results comparing listing to median across the open web; preliminary 4.1% add-to-cart lift in 50/50 holdout
Led guest-checkout-by-default rollout removing the forced-account-creation gate; mobile conversion up 11.4% with sustained gains through the quarter
Shipped Apple Pay and Google Pay across checkout with a six-week fraud-team handoff to recalibrate risk for tokenized payments; reached 22% of mobile checkouts within two quarters
Rebuilt address-entry with USPS-database autocomplete and international fallback; address-related support tickets down 41% and undeliverable-shipment refunds from 1.8% to 0.6% of mobile orders
Built post-purchase upsell rail for same-seller same-box adds; $14M annualized incremental revenue at +8% margin contribution
Partnered with Risk on smart-trigger 3DS step-up that only escalates the riskiest 3% of transactions; fraud chargebacks down 22% with <0.5% conversion friction
Owned site-wide checkout migration from Shopify Plus stock checkout to a Hydrogen-based custom checkout; cart-to-purchase conversion from 64% to 73% and mobile revenue share from 41% to 54%
Designed and shipped loyalty program with points, tiers, and early-access drops; 90-day repeat-purchase rate from 19% to 31% and LTV/CAC settling at 4.7 for members vs 2.8 for non-members
Built fits-like recommendation engine using purchase and return history; women's denim returns dropped from 38% to 22% over six months
Led headless-CMS migration from WordPress to Sanity with a Next.js front-end rebuild; p75 LCP dropped from 4.8s to 1.6s and organic traffic grew 60% YoY
Ran bundling experiments tying staple-tee SKU to a discounted three-pack; AOV up 23% on bundle landing pages and the three-pack remains a top-5 SKU
Built Cartwright — a browser extension that strips dark patterns from third-party checkouts (pre-checked add-ons, hidden fees, default-on subscriptions); ~600 WAU, open source
